introHtml: Rainbow golf polo shirts make a bold statement for Pride events, charity tournaments, or any occasion where your brand wants to stand out. Unlike standard solid-color polos, the rainbow palette offers a full spectrum of visibility and inclusivity. These custom polos are available in moisture-wicking performance fabrics, ideal for outdoor events. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on the chest or sleeve for a look that’s as functional as it is festive.
